operations.details: Verified official OGC OpenMI standard page.
Runtime model exchange separated from observed terrain measurement.
Simulation output not promoted to parcel elevation evidence.
Model-exchanged values require independent source and uncertainty validation.
Verified official OGC GeoRSS standard page.
Syndicated geographic tags separated from survey coordinates.
Feed location metadata not promoted to exact parcel geometry.
GeoRSS location rejected as terrain height or vertical-accuracy evidence.
OpenMI and GeoRSS URLs confirmed absent from prior source registry.
No simulation or feed value substituted for parcel result.
Canonical manifest untouched; serial publisher required.
